speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; can you tell me if the rash appears on the soles of your feet or your fingers as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda. The combination of a chronic itchy rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory symptoms in the palms, a history of alcohol or iron exposure (implied by farm work), and potential liver involvement fits this diagnosis best. REQUEST TEST: Urine_porphyrins, Liver_function_tests, Serum_iron
